---
title: "Courtney"
format: html
---
```{r}
#pulling datasets in
dataset <- load("data/wrangledData.Rdata")

#packages
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#| label: Coach Salary
ggplot(coach_box_plot, aes(x=Gender, y=Salary, file=Gender)) + 
    geom_boxplot(fill="slateblue", alpha=0.3) +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Coach Salary", y = "Salary (dollars)") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#| label: Student Aid
ggplot(aid_box_plot, aes(x=Gender, y=`Student Aid`, file=Gender)) + 
    geom_boxplot(fill="slateblue", alpha=0.3) +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Student Aid", y = "Student Aid (dollars)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: Recruitment Spending
ggplot(recruitment_box_plot, aes(x=Gender, y=Recruitment, file=Gender)) + 
geom_boxplot(fill="slateblue", alpha=0.3) +
labs(title = "Comparison of Recruitment Spending", y = "Recruitment Spending (dollars)") +
```
